command:
cat > /root/ansible/kmod-blacklist/blacklist-usb-storage.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Prevent usb_storage kernel module from loading
  hosts: node1
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Write modprobe blacklist config for usb_storage
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        set -e
        cat <<'CONF' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf > /dev/null
        blacklist usb_storage
        install usb_storage /bin/false
        CONF
      changed_when: true

    - name: Unload usb_storage module if currently loaded
      ansible.builtin.raw: |
        if /sbin/lsmod | grep -q '^usb_storage'; then
          sudo /sbin/modprobe -r usb_storage
          echo CHANGED
        else
          echo ALREADY_ABSENT
        fi
      register: unload_result
      changed_when: "'CHANGED' in unload_result.stdout"

    - name: Verify usb_storage is not loaded
      ansible.builtin.raw: "/sbin/lsmod | grep -c '^usb_storage' || true"
      register: verify_result
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: verify_result.stdout_lines[0] | trim != '0'
EOF
cd /root/ansible/kmod-blacklist && ansible-playbook -i inventory.ini blacklist-usb-storage.yml 2>&1
